market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month is around $104-108 with intraday range to $110 on Apr 30, 2026 due to Iran/Strait of Hormuz tensions. Question asks if CL hits $80 LOW by end of June - would require a $24+ drop in 2 months. Geopolitical risk premium is elevated; an oil crash to $80 would need a sudden detente plus weaker demand. Possible but unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden diplomatic breakthrough with Iran or unexpected OPEC+ production hike could collapse prices fast.
